mods.name: Simple Player Trades
mods.description: Adds a simple /trade <player> command to allow for easy trading between players.

releases.notes:
First release of the mod with the following features:

- Added `/trade <player>` command to send a trade request
- Added `/tradeaccept <player>` command to accept an incoming request
- Added `/tradedeny <player>` command to deny an incoming request
- Added `/tradecancel` command to cancel an outgoing request or active trade
- Added shared double chest trade GUI where each player sees their own items on the left
- Players can only interact with their own side of the trade window
- Shift-click support for moving items in and out of the trade window
- Both players must click the green accept button to confirm before the trade executes
- Clicking the red cancel button closes the trade and returns all items
- Moving items after confirming automatically resets your confirmation
- The center divider turns green when a player confirms, with a sound notification
- Closing the GUI at any time cancels the trade and returns all items safely
- Trade requests automatically expire after a configurable timeout
- Cooldown between trade requests to prevent spam
- Trade logging to file with full item details, stored in `config/simple-player-trades/logs/`
- Log files rotate automatically, keeping a configurable maximum number of files
- Config file at `config/simple-player-trades/config.properties` with commented options
- Server admins can disable trading entirely via config
- Server admins can restrict trading to opped players only via config
- Server-side only, no client mod required
